fusions.name: Shoulder Check
fusions.desc: A shoulder check that deals 4 damage, up to 1.3 times at maximum range. Its damage rises +10% for each ally near you (max +40%).

fusions.name: Gentle Heave
fusions.desc: Shoves every enemy within 3 tiles; each hit deals 12 damage and knocks them back 3 tiles. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Barn Warmth
fusions.desc: Warms the ground where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Settled Fleece
fusions.desc: Each time your health becomes full, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
